summary: Tested new Inventory module (backend + frontend) for Tienda Demo Pruebas. 14/14 backend tests passed (product CRUD, sales with Ecuador/USA stock deduction, insufficient-stock validation, stock adjust +/-, stats for week/w1/month/all with top products and margin). Frontend verified end-to-end: Dashboard shows 'Inventario' button, /admin/inventory loads with 5 KPIs (Productos, Stock Ecuador, Stock USA, Valor Stock, Stock Bajo), product creation modal works and new product appears in list with correct SKU/cost/price/stock/margin, Ventas Recientes list is populated, /admin/inventory-stats shows weekly KPIs (Ventas Totales, Costo Total, Ganancia Neta, Margen 57.2%), period filters (Esta semana, 28-Sept→5-Oct, 21-Sept→28-Sept, 14-Sept→21-Sept, 7-Sept→14-Sept, Este mes, Todo), tendencia de ventas chart, distribución de ventas, and Productos Más Vendidos table with cantidad/ventas/costo/ganancia/margen columns.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 10,848 lines; recommend splitting into feature modules (inventory, invoices, live, wallet, etc.) for maintainability.

POST /inventory/products returns {message, product} wrapper while GET /inventory/products returns a plain list; consider standardizing response shape across inventory endpoints to simplify frontend code.
Low-stock threshold (<5) is hardcoded in /inventory/stats; consider making it tenant-configurable.
seed_data_creation: Test created and cleaned up TEST_InvProduct_Zeta and UI_TEST_Prod_A. The agent-created 'Camiseta Deportiva' (SKU CAM-001) was NOT deleted. During testing, additional sales were recorded on 'Camiseta Deportiva' (now stock Ecuador=48, USA=25 unchanged) and on TEST product. Current state: 1 product remaining (Camiseta Deportiva).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inventory module endpoints: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/inventory/products, POST /api/inventory/sales (location: ecuador|usa, deducts stock), POST /api/inventory/products/{id}/adjust-stock (body: adjustment:int, location:str, reason:str), GET /api/inventory/stats?period=(week|w1|w2|month|all). Create endpoint returns {message, product} wrapper; same for update and sale. List returns plain array. Admin always sees Inventario menu (permission check short-circuits for admins).
